title: Tune a model and change it mid-session
steps: Open the model picker; inspect capability authority, availability and limits.
Review reasoning and generation compatibility; remove invalid overrides.
Read the apply timing: Next task or New conversation. Preserve the current draft.
Submit a new captured request. The executed call records its actual route and effective parameters.
If the change requires a new session, offer Create new conversation with the draft preserved.

treating a reasoning enum as a writable API
